data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 integrates with SRC_002 by composing SRC_005's minimal-fixture typed lease-mismatch assertion with SRC_002's forbidden generic-exception mutation, creating a single eval that asserts both temporal precedence and typed fidelity. The integration is refuted if SRC_005's minimal-fixture constraint depends on excluding the generic-exception mutation class, since SRC_002's mutation requires the fixture to resolve exception type hierarchies, increasing fixture cost beyond the single-frozen-lease bound.
